svg.title: Questions and draws have different roles

cc:Work.dc:title: Questions and draws have different roles
cc:Work.dc:description: Figure 2. Sampling and study roles. The primary panel contains 50 questions, eight independent draws per mode, and 800 responses, paired into 400 states by sample index. Each outer fold fits on 40 questions and evaluates on ten excluded questions. The diagram shows the four-draw A-to-B direction; B-to-A reverses the draw halves while retaining question separation. Direct drafts change across draws. Later controls and post-hoc diagnostics reuse these 50 questions. The separate 64-question panel supplies the 11-question cap subset and the development states used to refit the guard before its 228 fresh questions. The latter link indicates design influence, not shared questions or replication. Box sizes are schematic.
